g.text: The setup this guide builds: Docker Engine + Tailscale inside each WSL2 Ubuntu
Swarm traffic rides inside Tailscale's encrypted tunnels, so NATs and CGNAT stop mattering.
Friend 1 <-> Friend 3 (hard NAT on both sides): relayed through DERP, still end-to-end encrypted.
docker swarm init --advertise-addr $(tailscale ip -4) (on the manager)
docker swarm join --token <token> <manager tailscale IP>:2377 (on each worker)
